nonclaims: The observation does not prove this doctrine.
The observation does not establish endorsement of ggen-legacy.
The observation does not establish market adoption or production standing.

category_stack.definition: The transition from software production governed by manual implementation construction to machine-scale manufacture.
The condition in which mandatory human source inspection is removed from the production critical path and replaced by stronger admitted controls and evidence.
Manufacture governed by admitted requirements, planning, bounded authority, independent falsification, operational evidence, explicit standing, receipts, and replay.

The accountable human who governs mission, architecture, boundaries, risk, acceptance, verifier design, evidence interpretation, and irreversible decisions while machinery performs combinatorial construction and inspection.
The ggen-legacy contribution that reconstructs a legacy behavioral contract, manufactures a replacement, proves bounded closure, and computes release and predecessor-retirement decisions.

governing_thesis: The age of software governed primarily by humans reading and writing implementation is ending. Machine-scale production requires admitted specifications, architecture, full planning, bounded actuation, independent verification, operational evidence, explicit standing, receipts, and replay.
owned_problem: What replaces human code reading as the basis of software trust when machine implementation throughput exceeds human inspection throughput?

replacement_controls.replacement: admission, architecture conformance, executable specifications, independent falsification, operational evidence, standing, receipts, and replay

replacement_controls.manual_activity_removed: reviewer reconstruction of intent from a diff
replacement_controls.replacement: admitted requirements and explicit consequence models
typed standing computed over bounded evidence

hard_invariants: Code is intermediate manufacturing material, not the product.
The product is a verified business capability or conforming operational system.
Selection is not authorization and authorization is not execution.
Unknown evidence cannot be promoted into success.
Generated output cannot become a second authority.
No material actuation is accepted without a receipt.
A no-read claim is invalid unless the replacement control and independent verifier are named.
ALIVE requires exact-head evidence and independent replay.

project_mapping.contribution: Projects admitted semantic authority into applications, services, infrastructure, policies, tests, schemas, documentation, and evidence surfaces.
Reconstructs predecessor contracts and proves whether a manufactured replacement and predecessor retirement have standing.
Plans lawful deterministic work and probabilistic policies, including refusal, observation, recovery, and risk constraints.
Separates selection, authorization, and execution and enforces zero unreceipted actuation.
Establishes what executed, in which order, under which authority, and with which observable consequences.
Supplies pull, standardized work, jidoka, andon, poka-yoke, genchi genbutsu, five whys, kaizen, and receipt discipline.
Admit semantic authority, reject contradiction, and enforce architecture and policy constraints.
Kernel-check bounded production laws, authorization invariants, transition properties, and countermodels.
Explore deterministic, temporal, workflow, and stochastic routes from requirements to verified consequences.

benchmark.name: Post-Reading Throughput
benchmark.signature_demonstration: A bounded capability is manufactured, independently verified, receipted, and replayed while the accountable human reads zero implementation lines.

falsifiers: A human must inspect implementation to determine acceptance because requirements or evidence are insufficient.
The same agent-generated test suite is the only verifier of agent-generated implementation.
Architecture can drift without machine detection.
Missing evidence or silence is promoted into success.
Receipts cannot reproduce the production path.
An artifact receives ALIVE without independent replay.
The system cannot represent no-change or refusal as a successful outcome.
